title: Giving a Presentation
completion_message: ¡Excelente! Ya tienes las frases clave para dar una presentación profesional en inglés.

parts.visual:
Inicio: Welcome everyone (Bienvenidos todos). Thank you for coming (Gracias por venir). Today, I'm going to talk about... (Hoy voy a hablar de...). 
Estructura: First (Primero), Then (Luego), Finally (Finalmente).
parts.audio: Starting a presentation. Welcome everyone. Thank you for coming. Today, I'm going to talk about our new project. For structure we use: First, Then, and Finally.

parts.visual:
Desarrollo: Let's move on to the next slide (Pasemos a la siguiente diapositiva). As you can see on this graph... (Como pueden ver en este gráfico...). 
Cierre: In conclusion... (En conclusión...). Are there any questions? (¿Hay alguna pregunta?).
parts.audio: During the presentation. Let's move on to the next slide. As you can see on this graph... And to finish: In conclusion... Are there any questions?

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la frase correcta para cada momento de tu presentación.

questions.question: Thank you for ____ today. (Por venir).
questions.explanation: Después de 'for' (preposición), el verbo lleva -ing: coming.

questions.question: Today, I am going to ____ about our new strategy. (Hablar).
The ____ of my presentation is the Q3 budget. (Propósito/Objetivo).
questions.explanation: The purpose of my presentation = el propósito de mi presentación.

questions.question: I have divided my presentation into three ____. (Partes).
____, I will talk about the problem. (Primero).
____, I will show you the solution. (Luego/Después).
Let's ____ on to the next slide. (Pasemos/Avancemos).
questions.explanation: Move on to = pasar a / avanzar a (un nuevo tema o diapositiva).

questions.question: As you can ____ on this graph, sales are up. (Ver).
questions.explanation: As you can see = como pueden ver.

questions.question: This ____ shows our revenue for the year. (Gráfico/Tabla).
questions.explanation: Chart o Graph = gráfico (bar chart, pie chart).

questions.question: I would like to ____ that this is very important. (Enfatizar/Señalar).
questions.explanation: Point out = señalar / hacer notar algo importante.

questions.question: To ____ up, we need to reduce costs. (Para resumir).
In ____, the project was a success. (Conclusión).
That ____ me to the end of my presentation. (Me lleva).
questions.explanation: That brings me to the end = eso me lleva al final.

questions.question: Are there any ____? (Preguntas).
questions.explanation: Are there any questions? = ¿Hay alguna pregunta? (No se usa 'doubts' para esto).

questions.question: Thank you for your ____. (Atención).
questions.explanation: Thank you for your attention = gracias por su atención.

questions.question: I will be happy to ____ your questions now. (Responder).
If you look at the ____, you will see the numbers. (Pantalla).
questions.explanation: Screen = pantalla (donde se proyecta la presentación).

questions.question: Can everyone ____ me in the back? (Escucharme).
questions.explanation: Can everyone hear me? = ¿Me pueden escuchar todos?

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe la palabra clave para tu presentación.

questions.question: Today I am going to ____ about... (Hablar)
Let's ____ on to the next slide. (Pasemos)
As you can ____ on this graph... (Ver)
To ____ up, we must improve. (Para resumir)

stages.title: Listening Comprehension
stages.description: Escucha y selecciona la frase de presentación exacta.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
options: Thank you very much for coming.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: Today I am going to talk about sales.
options: Today I am going to talk about sales.
Today I will talk about sales.
I am going to talk about sales.
Today we are going to talk about sales.
questions.correct_answer: Today I am going to talk about sales.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: The purpose of my presentation is to show the results.
options: The purpose of my presentation is to show the results.
The goal of my presentation is to show the results.
The purpose is to show the results.
My presentation is to show the results.
questions.correct_answer: The purpose of my presentation is to show the results.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: Let's move on to the next slide.
options: Let's move on to the next slide.
Let's go to the next slide.
We will move to the next slide.
Let's move to the next slide.
questions.correct_answer: Let's move on to the next slide.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: As you can see on this graph.
options: As you can see on this graph.
As you can see in this chart.
Like you can see on this graph.
questions.correct_answer: As you can see on this graph.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: To sum up, we need to reduce costs.
options: To sum up, we need to reduce costs.
In summary, we need to reduce costs.
To sum up, we must reduce costs.
To sum up, we need to cut costs.
questions.correct_answer: To sum up, we need to reduce costs.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: In conclusion, the project was a success.
options: In conclusion, the project was a success.
In conclusion, it was a success.
To conclude, the project was a success.
In conclusion, the project is a success.
questions.correct_answer: In conclusion, the project was a success.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
options: Thank you very much for your attention.
